```python
def solve(case):
    threshold = case["threshold"]
    calls = case["calls"]
    
    accepted = []
    diagnostics = []
    
    for call in calls:
        call_id = call["call_id"]
        loss_without = call["loss_without_call"]
        loss_with = call["loss_with_call"]
        prediction_tokens = call["prediction_tokens"]
        parseable = call["parseable"]
        
        # Validate required fields
        if not isinstance(loss_without, (int, float)):
            raise ValueError(f"Invalid loss_without_call for {call_id}")
        if not isinstance(loss_with, (int, float)):
            raise ValueError(f"Invalid loss_with_call for {call_id}")
        if not isinstance(prediction_tokens, int) or prediction_tokens < 1:
            raise ValueError(f"Invalid prediction_tokens for {call_id}")
        
        gain = loss_without - loss_with
        normalized_gain = gain / prediction_tokens
        
        accepted_flag = parseable and normalized_gain >= threshold
        
        if accepted_flag:
            accepted.append(call_id)
        
        diagnostics.append({
            "call_id": call_id,
            "gain": round(gain, 8),
            "normalized_gain": round(normalized_gain, 8),
            "accepted": accepted_flag
        })
    
    return {
        "accepted_call_ids": accepted,
        "diagnostics": diagnostics
    }
```
